FlameShelf bundles these conversion libraries. Their license notices are included
in this directory or alongside the copied vendor assets.

ImageMagick for WebAssembly and native delegate sources
https://github.com/dlemstra/magick-wasm/tree/0.0.46
https://github.com/dlemstra/magick-native

Mediabunny 1.65.2, including the MP3 and FLAC encoder extensions
https://github.com/Vanilagy/mediabunny/tree/v1.65.2
https://www.npmjs.com/package/mediabunny/v/1.65.2
https://www.npmjs.com/package/@mediabunny/mp3-encoder/v/1.65.2
https://www.npmjs.com/package/@mediabunny/flac-encoder/v/1.65.2
https://lame.sourceforge.io/
https://github.com/xiph/flac

PDF.js
https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js

Libarchive.js 2.0.2
https://github.com/nika-begiashvili/libarchivejs
https://github.com/libarchive/libarchive

7-Zip WASM 1.2.0, based on 7-Zip 24.09
https://github.com/use-strict/7z-wasm/tree/v1.2.0
https://www.7-zip.org/a/7z2409-src.tar.xz

OGV.js 1.9.0 Ogg demuxer and Theora decoder
https://github.com/bvibber/ogv.js/tree/1.9.0
https://gitlab.xiph.org/xiph/ogg
https://gitlab.xiph.org/xiph/theora

SheetJS Community Edition 0.20.3
https://cdn.sheetjs.com/xlsx-0.20.3/xlsx-0.20.3.tgz

docx, gifenc, and Papa Parse
https://github.com/dolanmiu/docx
https://github.com/mattdesl/gifenc
https://github.com/mholt/PapaParse
